data.change_summary: Updated the habitat-geometry probe suite so the biofilter-scaling probe now matches its actual large-media scenario and validates reduced-nitrogen clearance plus end-of-run nitrifier biomass, while the substrate-redox probe now uses live rooted plants with equal decomposer loading, a thinner inert control, and explicit denitrifier maturation/decay checks instead of a pre-seeded mature state.
outstanding_risks: Validation was limited to `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_habitat_geometry_probes.rs`; I did not rerun the broader `tank_harness` or workspace test suites.

The worktree already contained unrelated modifications outside this test file (`crates/tank_harness/src/lib.rs`, `.claude/worktrees/...`, `.ralph-burning/`); I left them untouched and did not validate their impact here.

steps.description: Inspect the pending habitat-geometry probe amendments and compare them against the current biofilter and substrate-redox implementations.

Patch `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_habitat_geometry_probes.rs` so the biofilter probe checks the documented behavior and the redox probe uses live rooted plants, matched decomposer loading, and denitrifier maturation/decay assertions.
Format the workspace and run targeted validation for the updated habitat-geometry probe file.
